scope: Paired static request experiments, not a new native long trajectory. Historical contexts and summaries remain fixed across arms. No extra summary calls are made; prior summary cost is common and cancels in comparisons.
choice: One call either answers directly or requests recall. If recall is requested, a second answer call receives the same evidence as compact. No gold answer or required-retrieval label is provided to the model. Invalid decisions fall back to retrieval and are recorded.
gate: Report per-model accuracy, every paired regression, input/output tokens, calls, latency and all decision-call costs. Do not enable a new production default from this exploratory trial alone.
